user.title: Open Spot Forecast - Basic Settings
user.description: Configure your region and price settings

data_description.price_source: Stromligning's sensors (DK1 and DK2 only, consumer prices with tariffs) or the day-ahead auction price from energy-charts.info (all regions, spot price with VAT).
data_description.entsoe_api_key: Security token from the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform. Adds ENTSO-E's week-ahead load forecast to the model and is the price fallback when energy-charts.info has no prices. Stored in the config entry and never logged.

sensors.title: Open Spot Forecast - Sensor Configuration
sensors.description:
Configure data sources (all optional).

**Price sensors** (only used with the Stromligning price source)
**Weather sensors** (optional - score the local weather forecast for the confidence)

data.spot_price_sensor: Spot Price Sensor (raw spot price excl. VAT, used by the ML model)
data.spot_price_tomorrow_sensor: Spot Price Tomorrow Sensor (tomorrow's raw spot price excl. VAT)
data.prediction_hours: Prediction Hours (12 to 72; up to 168 with the compact format)
data.training_days: Training days (price history the model learns from)

error.stromligning_region: Stromligning only covers DK1 and DK2: choose the day-ahead price source for this region
error.entsoe_key_required: energy-charts.info does not cover this region: enter an ENTSO-E API key

init.title: Open Spot Forecast Options
init.description: Configure advanced options for spot price forecasting

data.prediction_hours: Prediction Hours (12 to 72; up to 168 with the compact format)
data.spot_price_sensor: Spot Price Sensor (raw spot price excl. VAT, used by the ML model)
data.spot_price_tomorrow_sensor: Spot Price Tomorrow Sensor (tomorrow's raw spot price excl. VAT)
data.training_days: Training days (price history the model learns from)

data_description.entsoe_api_key: Security token from the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform. Adds ENTSO-E's week-ahead load forecast to the model and is the price fallback when energy-charts.info has no prices. Stored in the config entry and never logged.
data_description.surcharge: Fixed amount in your currency per price unit, added to the spot price before VAT: total = (spot + surcharge) × (1 + VAT). Applies to the day-ahead prices and the forecast; Stromligning's prices already include it. Takes effect after the integration reloads.
data_description.hourly_average: Show the mean of each hour's four 15-minute prices, for contracts billed by the hour. Takes effect after the integration reloads.
data_description.attribute_format: Detailed: one entry per interval with start, end, price, unit and confidence (up to 72 hours). Compact: parallel arrays of start times (s, unix seconds), prices (t) and confidences in percent (c), about six times smaller, so up to 168 hours fit Home Assistant's 16 KB attribute limit. Takes effect after the integration reloads.

get_forecast.name: Get forecast
get_forecast.description: Returns the whole price forecast (up to 7 days past the known prices) as response data, converted like the forecast sensor: unit, surcharge and VAT.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The Open Spot Forecast entry (region) to read. Can be left out when only one is set up.

start.name: Start
start.description: Return the forecast from the interval containing this time. Default: now.

hours.name: Hours
hours.description: Number of hours to return from the start. Default: the whole forecast.

hourly.name: Hourly
hourly.description: Average the four 15-minute prices of each hour. Default: the entry's hourly average option.

ml_prediction_disabled.message: ML predictions are disabled for {entry_title}, so it has no forecast
